name: Exp_SimpleBars
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom SimpleBars indicator, which analyzes bar color patterns over a configurable period. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals a bullish shift and sell positions on a bearish shift, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options. The strategy only processes signals on new bars to avoid redundant entries.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义SimpleBars指标的信号进行交易，该指标通过可配置周期的K线颜色模式分析趋势方向。当指标发出看涨转换信号时开多仓，发出看跌转换信号时开空仓，并支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。策略仅在新K线形成时处理信号以避免重复入场。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于SimpleBars自定义指标生成的K线颜色信号进行交易决策。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的值为0且前一根值为1时，产生买入开仓信号；当值为1且前一根值为0时，产生卖出开仓信号。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的止损和止盈点数。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制每笔交易的风险敞口。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线周期仅计算一次信号，避免在同一根K线内重复交易。整体策略逻辑简洁，属于典型的K线颜色趋势跟踪方法。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy generates trade decisions based on signals from the SimpleBars custom indicator, which analyzes bar color patterns. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 4 reads 0 with the previous bar reading 1, a buy open signal is generated; when it reads 1 with the previous bar reading 0, a sell open signal is generated. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals closing existing positions, combined with fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing supports multiple modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage after loss adjustments for both free margin and balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration to regulate risk exposure per trade. The strategy employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar period, preventing redundant trades within the same bar. Overall, the strategy logic is straightforward, representing a typical bar-color trend following approach.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制交易仓位大小比例
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling position size ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode: Free margin/Balance/Post-loss margin/Post-loss balance/Fixed lot

parameters.name: useclose
parameters.description: 是否在指标计算中使用收盘价
parameters.description_en: Use close price in indicator calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Bar index for trade signal retrieval

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，基于K线颜色趋势跟踪，易于理解和维护
支持多种仓位管理模式，灵活适配不同风险偏好
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易，减少不必要的交易频率
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制框架
买卖开仓和平仓可独立开关控制，提供精细化的交易方向管理
pros_en: Strategy logic is clean and straightforward, based on bar color trend following, easy to understand and maintain
Supports multiple position sizing modes, flexibly adapting to different risk preferences
Uses new bar detection mechanism to prevent redundant trades within the same bar, reducing unnecessary trading frequency
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
Buy/sell open and close can be independently toggled, offering granular control over trading direction
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标SimpleBars，增加了部署复杂性和依赖风险
止损止盈使用固定点数而非ATR等动态指标，在不同波动率环境下可能不适用
缺乏价差过滤机制，在高价差环境下可能导致不利成交
没有最大持仓数量限制或连续亏损保护机制
指标信号逻辑简单，可能在震荡行情中产生频繁的虚假信号导致反复亏损
cons_en: Depends on an external custom SimpleBars indicator, increasing deployment complexity and dependency risk
Uses fixed point stop loss/take profit rather than dynamic indicators like ATR, which may be unsuitable across varying volatility environments
Lacks spread filter mechanism, which can lead to unfavorable fills in high-spread conditions
No maximum position count limit or consecutive loss protection mechanism
Simple indicator signal logic may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to repeated losses
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈替代固定点数，以适应不同市场波动率
增加价差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提升风险控制能力
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit to replace fixed points, adapting to different market volatility
Add spread filtering and maximum position count limits to enhance risk control capabilities

risk_points: 固定止损止盈在低波动率市场可能过大导致不必要的损失
缺乏价差过滤可能在高价差时段产生不利成交
震荡行情中K线颜色频繁切换可能导致反复开平仓造成连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit may be disproportionately large in low-volatility markets causing unnecessary losses
Lack of spread filtering can produce unfavorable fills during high-spread periods
Frequent bar color changes in ranging markets may cause repeated open/close cycles leading to consecutive losses
